title: A Ember for the Thorn Again
author: Rafael Marchetti
blurb: Theo Thornbury, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
